title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Thank you, families
hook: Who made this season possible besides the kids?
intro: Rides, snacks, laundry, and early mornings.
Most of it happened without a word.
statement: A season runs on families as much as coaches.
q1: Do you thank parents with a note or small gesture —
q2: or a simple thank-you at the last game?
q3: Who did the most behind the scenes?
t1: Both can work. But families come back
t2: when they know their help mattered.
cta: Coaches — how do you thank families?
ctaLines: A card. A shout-out. A team photo.
ctaPrompt: Share your thank-you habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who made this season possible besides the kids?
Rides, snacks, laundry, and early mornings. Most of it happened without a word.
A season runs on families as much as coaches.
A note or a simple thank-you. There is no single right way.
How do you thank families? Share your habit in the comments.
